t: Mi shello hitpallel lesibbat taut o ones
s: Mi shello hitpallel lesibbat taut o ones ubo y"ch seipim: taa o neenas velo hitpallel shacharit — tzarik lehitpallel mincha shettayim, harishona leshem mincha vehab' letashlumin, shetztzarik lehaqdim tepillat hammincha shehi chobat shaa litpillat hattashlumin. Veim hapak, shehayeta bedato shettehe harishona letashlumin — lo yatza yede chobat tepilla shehi letashlumin, vetzarik lachazor otah achar hattepilla shehu chobat shaa (lepi shello tiqqenu tashlumin ella kesheoseq bitpilla shehi chobat shaa, sheaz chozer umashlim mah sheppasaq bitpillotayv, velo qodem laken velo achar kak, kemo sheyyitbaer). Veken haddin bekol maqom shetztzarik lehitpallel tepilla letashlumin. Veyesh mepaqpeqim lomar sheen tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel ella im ken gilla dato beperush bitpillato shehashsheniyya hi leshem choba veharishona letashlumin, ukegon shehu motzae shabbat vehibdil bashsheniyya velo hibdil barishona kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lechaddesh ezeh dabar keshechozer umitpallel, sheaz en chashash beraka lebattala ledibre hakkol, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"z seip a':

Taa o neenas velo hitpallel mincha — tzarik lehitpallel arbit shettayim, harishona leshem arbit vehab' letashlumin. Veap al pi shehattepillot hen keneged haqqorbanot — en omerim kevan sheabar yomo batel qorbano, kevan shemmikkol maqom hattepillot hen baqqashat harachamim, vekol emat sheyyitpallel yesh lo sekar tepilla, ella sheen lo sekar tepilla bizmannah:

Taa o neenas velo hitpallel arbit — mitpallel shacharit shettayim, harishona leshem shacharit vehashsheniyya letashlumin. Veasur leekol ad sheyyitpallel hashsheniyya. Veim hitchil — en tzarik lehapsiq:
Abal qeriat shema yesh omerim sheen lah tashlumin, ubirkot qeriat shema ledibre hakkol en lahen tashlumin, kemo shennitbaer besiman n"ch:

Vetob shello yitpallel letashlumin miyyad achar tepillat shacharit, ella yapsiq benehem be"ashre" (sheachar "nepilat appayim") kede laamod gam bitpillat tashlumin mittok dibre tanchumin shel tora, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"d seip b'. Veken keshemmitpallel mincha shettayim o arbit shettayim — tob lomar "ashre" ben tepilla litpilla, ap al pi shemmin haddin day bishhiyya kede hilluk d' ammot kemo shennitbaer besiman q"h. Ak hazzohar hizhir shello lomar mizmor "tehilla ledavid" achar mincha o achar arbit, ella im ken yomrennu keqore battora velo betorat choba:
Mi shetztzarik lehitpallel shacharit shettayim o mincha shettayim vehu sheliach tzibbur — yotze bemah shemmachazir hattepilla beqol ram:

En tashlumin litpilla shehipsid ella bizman tepilla (hassemuka lah) abal lo beshaa sheenah zeman tepilla, kegon im shaha harbeh achar shehitpallel tepilla shehi chobat shaa — eno yakol lehitpallel od letashlume tepilla shehipsid, lepi shello tiqqenu tashlumin litpilla shehipsid ella bizman sheoseq bitpilla shehi chobat shaa, sheaz kevan shehu asuq bitpilla hu chozer umashlim mah sheppasha bitpillotayv:

Lo tiqqenu tashlumin ella litpilla hassemuka lah bilbad, kegon im taa velo hitpallel shacharit velo mincha — mitpallel arbit shettayim, haacharona letashlume mincha shehi tepilla hassemuka learbit, abal shacharit en lah tashlumin. Veken bishar tepillot. Umikkol maqom, im taa velo hitpallel shacharit beshabbat — mitpallel mincha shettayim ap al pi shekkebar abar musap, lepi sheen inyan lemusap im shacharit umincha shehem bimqom hattemidim, velaken hem niqraot semukot zo lazo ap al pi shehammusap mapsiq benehem, kevan shehu inyan acher legamre:

Ap al pi sheen tashlumin ella litpilla hassemuka leotah tepilla utepillot acherot shehipsid en lahem tashlumin, mikkol maqom im rotzeh lehitpallel otan nedaba vesheyyechaddesh bahen dabar kemo shennitbaer besiman q"z — hareshut beyado, venakon laasot ken. Velaken mi shehaya choleh o tapus bitpisa velo haya hammaqom naqi — nakon haddabar shekkesheyyetze yitpallel kol hattepillot shehipsid vichaddesh bahen dabar. Veim yatza mittepisa berosh chodesh — mazkir bekullan yaaleh veyabo. (Abal im yatza beshabbat — lo yashlimen bindaba ad lemachar kemo shennitbaer besiman q"z):

Abar kol hayyom velo hitpallel musap — en lah tashlumin, shehaek yiqra haqqorbanot ukebar abar zeman musap, vegam lo tiqqenu z' berakot shel musap ella mishshum "uneshallema parim sepatenu" bilbad, ubazeh vadday abar zemanno batel qorbano. Abal shear tepillot shehen baqqashat harachamim ulevay sheyyitpallel kol hayyom:

Lo tiqqenu tashlumin ella leshogeg o leanus, abal mi shehezid velo hitpallel tepilla achat — en lah tashlumin apillu battepilla hassemuka lah, vealayv neemar: "meuvvat lo yukal litqon vego'". Umikkol maqom im rotzeh — yitpallel oto nedaba veen tzarik chiddush, shekkevan sheim haya shogeg haya chayyab lehashlimah beli shum chiddush, veakshav shehu mitpallel bindaba oseh mezid keshogeg, veyesh lo sekar tepillat tachanunim ubaqqashat rachamim, ella sheen lo sekar tepillat mitzva ella sekar tepillat hareshut:

Eno niqra mezid ella keshemmebattel hattepilla bishat benepesh beli shum tirda, abal mi shehaya tarud betzorek mamono shello yabo lide hepsed veal yede kak hipsid millehitpallel — ap al pi sheasa shello kaddin, sheasur laabor zeman tepilla mishshum hepsed mamon, mikkol maqom eno niqra mezid uposhea leinyan shello yehe tashlumin litpillato. Veken mi shehaya shikkor velo haya yodea hazzeman — chashub ones, ap al pi shehitchil lishtot achar shehiggia zeman hattepilla mippene shehaya sabur sheyyihyeh lo shehut lehitpallel leachar sheyyapig min hayyayin hammuat shehitchil lishtot bedea meyushshebet veachar kak nimshak libbo achar hammishteh veshakach al hattepilla venishtakker kol kak ad shello nishar shehut lehasir yeno mealayv terem abor zeman hattepilla. Veken mi shehaya mitasseq beezeh eseq velo hitpallel beod shehaya lo zeman lehitpallel mippene shehaya sabur sheadayin yishshaer lo zeman leachar sheyyigmor oto eseq shehu mitasseq bo uben kak uben kak shakach al hattepilla venimshak beisqo ad sheabar zeman hattepilla — eno niqra mezid, shehashshokeach keanus hu, veyesh lo tashlumin apillu im haeseq hu mehaasaqim haasurim mishshehiggia zeman hattepilla vehu hitchil beeseq zeh beissur, kevan shello bittel hattepilla bishat benepesh ella haya sabur lehitpallel achar sheyyigmor haeseq veshakach achar kak:

Mi shebba lebet hakkeneset samuk learbit veyarad lipne hatteba vehitpallel arbit mibbeod yom vaadayin lo hitpallel mincha — en ledammoto lehezid velo hitpallel, kevan sheadayin lo abar zeman hammincha, lepikak tzarik lehitpallel mincha miyyad. Veap im timtza lomar shei epshar lo lehitpallel tepillat hammincha beotah shaa kevan shekkebar asao layla bitpillat arbit, mikkol maqom lo yehe ella arbit shettayim vehashsheniyya letashlume mincha. Veim hu rosh chodesh — yazkir yaaleh veyabo gam bashsheniyya, kevan shekkebar qibbel alayv rosh chodesh:

Taa velo hitpallel mincha beereb shabbat — mitpallel arbit shettayim shel shabbat, harishona leshem arbit vehashsheniyya letashlumin. Veim hitpallel hashsheniyya shel chol — lo yatza yede tashlumin, sheen tepilla beshabbat beli hazkarat shabbat. Veken im lo hitpallel mincha beereb rosh chodesh — mitpallel arbit shettayim shel rosh chodesh. Veim amar "yaaleh veyabo" barishona velo bashsheniyya o shello amar bishtehen — en tzarik lachazor, sheen chozerin bishbil hazkarat rosh chodesh bearbit, mippene sheen meqaddeshin et hachodesh ballayla kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tk"b. Abal im hizkir bashsheniyya velo barishona — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel bishbil tashlumin, lepi sheggilla dato shekkivven barishona leshem tashlume minchat ereb rosh chodesh velaken lo hizkir bah shel rosh chodesh ubashsheniyya kivven leshem arbit shel rosh chodesh, vehammaqdim tepillat tashlumin litpilla shehi chobat shaa — lo yatza yede tashlumin kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vehu sheasa ken bemezid, abal im shakach lehazkir barishona — en tzarik lachazor, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Taa velo hitpallel arbit berosh chodesh vehitpallel shacharit shettayim veshakach yaaleh veyabo bab' — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel, ap al pi shehu letashlume arbit ubearbit en chozerin bishbil hazkarat rosh chodesh, zehu mippene sheen qiddush hachodesh ballayla, abal akshav shemmitpallel otah bayyom — tzarik lachazor ulehitpallel:

Taa velo hitpallel mincha beshabbat — mitpallel arbit bemotzae shabbat shettayim shel chol, mabdil barishona veeno mabdil bashsheniyya, lepi shehabdala day bepaam achat mah sheen ken behazkarat rosh chodesh shetztzarik lehazkir bekol hattepillot shebbahen laken tzarik gam ken lehazkir bitpillat tashlumin shemmitpallel bahem kemo shennitbaer. Veim hibdil bishtehen — yatza. Veken im lo hibdil bishtehen — en tzarik lachazor, sheen chozerin bishbil hazkarat habdala battepilla hoil veyakol leomrah al hakkos, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rtz"d. Abal im lo hibdil barishona vehibdil bashsheniyya — sheniyya olta lo leshem arbit, rishona lo olta, vetzarik lachazor ulehitpallel y"ch letashlume mincha, lepi sheggilla dato shekkivven barishona leshem tashlume minchat shabbat velaken lo hibdil bah ubashsheniyya kivven leshem arbit motzae shabbat. Vehu shello hibdil bemezid, abal im shakach millehabdil bah — en tzarik lachazor, shehare lo gilla dato kevan sheasa belo daat:

Taa bemincha shel shabbat vehitpallel y"ch velo hizkir shel shabbat, ap al pi shello yatza yede chobato vetzarik lachazor ulehitpallel im hu nizkar mibbeod yom, mikkol maqom im lo nizkar ad shechoshka — en tzarik lehitpallel arbit shettayim, shehare bearbit gam ken lo yitpallel raq y"ch shel chol kemo shehitpallel bemincha velo yarviach kelum betashlumin ellu. Veyesh omerim shekkevan shello yatza bemincha — hare zeh keillu lo hitpallel kelal, shetztzarik lehitpallel arbit shettayim. Vehaddabar mukra, velatzet yede sapeq — yitpallel hab' betorat nedaba veen tzarik lechaddesh bah dabar, shekkevan shemmitpallel al hassapeq en leka chiddush gadol mizzeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"z. Veken im lo hizkir yaaleh veyabo bemincha shel rosh chodesh uballayla eno rosh chodesh. Abal im ballayla gam ken rosh chodesh — tzarik lehitpallel arbit shettayim ledibre hakkol, shehare yarviach hazkarat yaaleh veyabo bitpillat tashlumin. Veken haddin belel yom tob b'. Vehu haddin im shakach "veten tal umatar" o "mashshib haruach", sheyyarviach otam bitpillat tashlumin:

Hattoeh umazkir meora shear yamim bitpilla shello bizmannah, kegon "yaaleh veyabo" shello berosh chodesh vechullo shel moed, o shel shabbat veyom tob bechol, im nizkar shettaa — poseq miyyad apillu beemtza habberaka. Veim lo nizkar ad leachar sheggamar habberaka o kol hattepilla — yesh omerim sheen hazkarat meora shear yamim chashubim hepseq battepilla lehatzrikah lachazor larosh o litchillat habberaka shehipsiq bah. Veyesh omerim sheddino keillu hipsiq besicha beemtza hattepilla, shetztzarik lachazor larosh o litchillat habberaka shehipsiq bah al derek shennitbaer besiman q(y)"d. (Uleinyan halaka) ap al pi shessepeq berakot lehaqel, mikkol maqom battepilla hoil vehalvay sheyyitpallel adam kol hayyom, lepikak kol maqom shehaddabar mukra — yachazor veyitpallel betorat nedaba veen tzarik lechaddesh bah dabar, kemo shennitbaer:
